description: This file defines the IndexingTaskManager class, a scoped service responsible for managing indexing tasks in a database, including creating, retrieving, and flushing tasks with deduplication and batch processing.

classes.name: IndexingTaskManager
classes.description: A scoped service class that manages indexing tasks, including creation, retrieval, and batch processing with deduplication.

methods.name: CreateTaskAsync
methods.description: Creates a new indexing task and schedules a flush if the queue was previously empty.

methods.name: GetIndexingTasksAsync
methods.description: Retrieves indexing tasks from the database after a specified task ID, filtered by category.

methods.name: FlushAsync
methods.description: Flushes the queued tasks to the database, removing duplicates and batching deletions and insertions.
